annotations.title: Get outcrop field photos near a point

description: Use when the user asks for field photographs of outcrops or rock samples near a point in Western Australia (GSWA's WAROX field database). Returns, for the nearest WAROX sites and samples that have photographs, their description and each photo's address and caption, served by DMIRS (waroxphotos.demirs.wa.gov.au; credit "Photo: GSWA WAROX field database (DMIRS), CC BY 4.0").
